notes: Muscle-balance card: the bars and the radar now use the same effort-weighted scale as the status and score, with the raw set count still shown and labelled raw
Bodyweight load factors: the gate now admits every movement that has a factor, so lunges, split squats, step-ups, calf raises, inverted rows and v-ups are counted instead of being silently dropped
Track-as: the Log screen's mode override now saves for short exercise ids too - it used to skip ids 9 to 99, including Bench Press id 73
Removed the dead 'Hide from lists' button from the exercise detail modal - it had no listener and did nothing
